narrative:
The FY2026 change portfolio totals EUR 24M across 11 initiatives — about 12% of group opex — and is expected to deliver EUR 12.7M of run-rate benefit from FY2027, a portfolio payback of 1.9 years against a 2.5-year hurdle.

Core banking modernisation is the largest item (EUR 6M), but vendor milestones have slipped, so part of the FY2026 envelope cannot be absorbed. Meanwhile three data & AI initiatives — the private-banking advice copilot, the Oracle-to-Snowflake-Postgres pricing migration and driver-based FP&A on Snowflake — have the fastest paybacks and directly support the cost and wealth-growth targets.

Driver-based FP&A on the actuals already in the Aktia DW on Snowflake replaces a planned Anaplan licence and shortens the budget cycle.

signals.title: FP&A Session — Anaplan Alternative on Snowflake
signals.excerpt: Head of FP&A, CDO and Chief Data Architect to review driver-based planning on the actuals already in the Aktia data warehouse on Snowflake (session 23 Oct).

signals.title: Pricing Tool Migration — Oracle to Snowflake Postgres
signals.excerpt: Legacy Oracle pricing tool scheduled for migration to Snowflake Postgres, removing licence cost and manual price-list reconciliation.

signals.title: Aktia Strategy 2026 — Efficiency & Wealth Growth
signals.excerpt: Board reconfirms financial targets: cost-to-income below 60% and ROE above 12%. Growth priority is wealth management; banking services to be developed through digital channels.
